WHERE 1 = 1 AND status = #{status}

mapper.select:
SELECT id, task_no, original_file_name, storage_provider, storage_key, status, total_count, success_count, failure_count, error_file_key, started_at, finished_at, created_by, created_at FROM invoice_import_task
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_import_task (task_no, original_file_name, storage_provider, storage_key, status, total_count, success_count, failure_count, started_at, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{originalFileName}, #{storageProvider}, #{storageKey}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{startedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO invoice_import_row_error (task_id, row_no, taxpayer_id, error_code, error_message, raw_data_json, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{rowNo}, #{taxpayerId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{rawDataJson}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_import_row_error WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
